'''Ritinki''' was a Bimm [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Ritinki attended a meeting with [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] kingpin [[Vop]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''; during the summit, the Bimm was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Cecil Noone]] and [[Cecil Noone's crew|his crew]], and his [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Asaari Wind]]'' was stolen by the outlaws. Subsequently, Ritinki's heirs each put out warrants on Noone's life.

==Behind the scenes==
Ritinki first appeared in "[[The Great Herdship Heist]]" , a short story written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15]]. While Ritinki is identified as a Bimm, it is not stated whether he is a member of either the [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|furred]] or [[Bimm/Legends|near-Human]] Bimm species.<ref name="GHH" />
